gloss_en: South Africa's construction regulator publishes a 2025-2030 national BIM adoption strategy; 2026 phase is governance and standards, with no mention of IFC or openBIM.
question_paraphrase: What does South Africa's national BIM strategy require, and does it name IFC or any standard?
phrasing_notes: official policy prose, no IFC wording; implies local users will ask what format to deliver
answer_summary: Strategy period 2025-2030 led by cidb with a National BIM Steering Committee; interventions include national BIM framework, BIM-enabled procurement guidance, skills and maturity benchmarking; 2026 focuses on governance and standards; IFC not named.

gloss_en: A poster asks BIM professionals what the most frustrating part of their daily work is and how much time it wastes.
question_paraphrase: what is the most annoying thing in your day to day bim work and how much time do you lose to it
phrasing_notes: short survey-style post with a typo in the title; no software or region given; zero replies at time of reading
answer_summary: No replies at time of reading; region and software not stated.

gloss_en: A learner asks what is most frustrating about Navisworks; the moderator archived it as not relevant to openBIM.
title_original: bottlenecks of current version of navisworks.
question_paraphrase: which part of navisworks do you find most frustrating, i am just trying to learn the software
phrasing_notes: lowercase title with trailing full stop; beginner framing; off-topic for openBIM forum
answer_summary: Single moderator reply: topic not relevant to openBIM solutions, thread archived.

gloss_en: Check a model before submission to a Gulf municipality: every element needs a classification and a few mandatory properties.
prompt: need to submit this to the municipality tomorrow. can u check every wall, slab and door has a classification code + fire rating + level name filled? list whatever is missing
expected_behavior: Iterate walls, slabs, doors; check classification references, Pset FireRating, and containing storey; return a grouped list of missing items with GlobalIds and counts; do not invent authority-specific rules.

gloss_en: Find how many elements exported as proxy and which Revit categories they came from.
prompt: consultant sent IFC from revit and half the stuff is proxy. how many IfcBuildingElementProxy and what categories were they
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by ObjectType and Revit category property, report counts and suggest export mapping fixes.

gloss_en: Total concrete volume by storey and check units are metres.
prompt: give me total concrete volume per level from the structural ifc, and confirm the units are m3 not mm3, the numbers look off
expected_behavior: Read project length/volume units, sum NetVolume or Qto_*BaseQuantities for concrete elements per storey, flag unit scale issues, report table.

gloss_en: Compare two issued models and list what changed.
prompt: compare rev B and rev C of the architectural model. what was added, deleted or moved? just give me the list by level
expected_behavior: Match elements by GlobalId, report added, removed, and changed (placement or properties) grouped by storey; note when GUIDs were regenerated.

gloss_en: Add a custom property to all doors from a list.
prompt: pls add a property 'AssetCode' to all doors using the numbers in my sheet (door mark -> code). will send the csv
expected_behavior: Match IfcDoor by Name/Tag to CSV mark, create a property set with AssetCode, report unmatched marks, save a new file without overwriting original.

gloss_en: Model sits kilometres from origin; find the georeferencing.
prompt: model opens far from origin in the viewer. what coordinate system is it using? is there an IfcMapConversion, what are eastings northings
expected_behavior: Report IfcProjectedCRS and IfcMapConversion if present, else say absent; show site placement and bounding box; suggest fix.

gloss_en: List ducts and pipes not assigned to any system.
prompt: which ducts/pipes are not in any system? chiller plant room first
expected_behavior: Find IfcDuctSegment/IfcPipeSegment without IfcRelAssignsToGroup to an IfcSystem, filter by space or storey, list with GlobalIds.

gloss_en: Room schedule with areas and finishes for handover.
prompt: room schedule pls - room no, name, area, floor finish, level. export to excel
expected_behavior: Read IfcSpace with Qto area and finish properties, group by storey, output a table and offer CSV/XLSX; warn on missing data.

gloss_en: Huge file that is slow on a laptop; find what is heavy.
prompt: this ifc is 900MB and my laptop dies. what is making it so big? can we strip out the furniture and landscaping
expected_behavior: Report element counts and geometry weight by class, identify heavy classes, offer a reduced copy without selected classes.

gloss_en: Check structural members have material and grade.
prompt: do all beams and columns have material and concrete grade? C40 / C50 only
expected_behavior: Check IfcBeam and IfcColumn material assignments and grade property, list members with missing or other grades.

gloss_en: Which IFC version and view to export for a client who just said IFC.
prompt: client says deliver in IFC. ifc2x3 or ifc4? what is coordination view? im using revit 2023
expected_behavior: Explain IFC2x3 vs IFC4 and Coordination View vs Reference View; advise confirming with EIR; give Revit export setting names.

gloss_en: Door and window openings missing in IFC export.
prompt: windows are showing but wall openings are missing in the ifc from revit. walls solid. what setting
expected_behavior: Check whether IfcOpeningElement and voids relations exist; advise on export options for openings and wall-hosted elements.

gloss_en: Test a contractor model against the employer's information requirements.
prompt: can you test this model against our EIR? we need manufacturer, model and warranty on all mechanical equipment. tell me pass or fail per item
expected_behavior: Check IfcFlowTerminal/IfcFlowController etc. for Manufacturer, ModelLabel, warranty properties, return pass/fail per element with summary; propose IDS if repeated.

gloss_en: Script to batch-process a folder of IFC files.
prompt: how do i loop over 40 ifc files in a folder and dump all wall areas to one csv with ifcopenshell
expected_behavior: Explain a loop with ifcopenshell.open, element selection by class, quantity reading, and writing a single CSV with file name column.

gloss_en: Check storey names and elevations against the project standard.
prompt: list all levels with elevation. do names follow L00, L01 ... format? flag the odd ones
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey with names and elevations, test naming pattern, flag deviations and duplicates.
